description: Observed 2026-08-20 on stack #166 CI (S3 MinIO job): test/bedrock/internal/transaction_builder_test.exs:319 'unknown info messages crash the process' - the crash happens (FunctionClauseError logged) but assert_receive {:DOWN,...} times out at the default 100ms on a loaded runner; rerun passed. File untouched by the stack. Likely fix: attach the monitor before provoking the crash (if not already) and/or raise the assert_receive timeout - the assertion is about the crash occurring, not about it occurring within 100ms.

comments.text: Reproduced during bedrock-xfc validation on Elixir1.17.3 / OTP27.3.3, seed346337: TransactionBuilderTest line319 failed waiting 100ms for DOWN at line328; FunctionClauseError was logged as expected. No related source changes in xfc. Full-suite same-seed rerun underway.
Same-seed full-suite rerun also failed the same 100ms DOWN assertion on OTP27.3.3/Elixir1.17.3. Both logs show expected FunctionClauseError, only delivery deadline fails.
The isolated test at line319 passes with the same toolchain and seed346337; failure remains specific to the full-suite run.

title: Flaky test: TransactionBuilderTest unknown-info crash misses 100ms DOWN window on loaded CI
